# AstroGate Protocol (llms.txt)
> The Decentralized Fair-Launch & AMM Platform on Stellar/Soroban.

AstroGate is a Web3 token launchpad and automated market maker (AMM) operating directly on Stellar Soroban. It provides 100% on-chain, verifiable token fair-launches ($1.11 USD deploy fee, 0.5% creator max allocation vested after graduation, 99.5% Soroswap AMM pool, mandatory LP burn to dead address, and ownership renunciation).

## Core Network & Contracts (Testnet)
- Network: Stellar Testnet (`Test SDF Network ; September 2015`)
- RPC Endpoint: https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org
- Horizon API: https://horizon-testnet.stellar.org
- Soroswap Factory: CDP3HMUH6SMS3S7NPGNDJLULCOXXEPSHY4JKUKMBNQMATHDHWXRRJTBY
- Soroswap Router: CCJUD55AG6W5HAI5LRVNKAE5WDP5XGZBUDS5WNTIVDU7O264UZZE7BRD
- Native XLM SAC: CDLZFC3SYJYDZT7K67VZ75HPJVIEUVNIXF47ZG2FB2RMQQVU2HHGCYSC
- Genesis ASTRO Token: CAI637WCEILQF3ZYOV6BRUCX532XQIVOOJ4CRWFPWHQRJHOH5OKHSXRE
- ASTRO/XLM AMM Pair: CA32TMZ2AODXI7K7B6T2YPZR52HJKFCY5GT2DNHMOL326DLSNPX55BUP
- LP Burn Address: GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAWHF
- Token WASM Hash: 5930d6c69894f5cd6924e1a7d8d10282448c7c18de0143dce76e92884c39786b

## AI Agent Integration & SDK
Developers and autonomous AI agents can interact with the protocol programmatically using the `@astrogate/sdk` modules located at `src/sdk/index.ts`:

### 1. Query Active Market
```typescript
import { getMarketTokens } from './src/sdk'

// Fetch top tokens with real-time pricing and liquidity
const tokens = await getMarketTokens({ maxTokens: 20 })
// Returns: Array<{ id, name, symbol, decimals, pairId, priceXlm, reserveToken, reserveXlm, graduationPercent, isGraduated }>
```

### 2. Quote AMM Swap
```typescript
import { quoteSwap } from './src/sdk'

// Quote buying 10 XLM worth of a token
const buyQuote = await quoteSwap({
  tokenId: 'CAI637WCEILQF3ZYOV6BRUCX532XQIVOOJ4CRWFPWHQRJHOH5OKHSXRE',
  amountIn: 100_000_000n, // 10 XLM (7 decimals)
  direction: 'buy',
  slippagePercent: 2,
})
```

### 3. Verify Anti-Rug Status
```typescript
import { verifyAntiRug } from './src/sdk'

const audit = await verifyAntiRug(tokenId)
// audit.isAntiRugVerified === true if 100% LP burned to GAAAA...WHF and ownership renounced
```

## Function Calling / Tool Definitions for LLM Agents
```json
[
  {
    "name": "get_market_tokens",
    "description": "Returns list of active tokens, liquidity reserves, and live XLM/USD prices on AstroGate",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "maxTokens": { "type": "number", "description": "Maximum number of tokens to return (default 20)" }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "quote_swap",
    "description": "Calculates exact AMM swap output between XLM and any launchpad token",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["tokenId", "amountIn", "direction"],
      "properties": {
        "tokenId": { "type": "string", "description": "Stellar contract address of token" },
        "amountIn": { "type": "string", "description": "Amount in stroops / base units (7 decimals)" },
        "direction": { "type": "string", "enum": ["buy", "sell"], "description": "buy = XLM->Token, sell = Token->XLM" },
        "slippagePercent": { "type": "number", "description": "Max slippage percentage (default 2)" }
      }
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "verify_anti_rug",
    "description": "Audits whether a token has 100% LP permanently burned to GAAAA...WHF and ownership renounced",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["tokenId"],
      "properties": {
        "tokenId": { "type": "string", "description": "Stellar contract address of token" }
      }
    }
  }
]
```

## Security & Architectural Guarantees
- No Backend Auth: Identity is verified exclusively via ED25519 cryptographic signatures from Stellar wallets.
- Atomic Settling: Token balances and LP shares are stored in Soroban ledger state with TTL extension.
- Multi-Oracle Fallback: Real-time USD pricing derived from Coinbase, Binance, and CoinGecko with in-memory caching.
